title: PodShpere
tagline: a podcast comment web extension, which an integrate comments from different platforms, including apple podcast, google podcast and spotify.
description:
PodShpere is a podcast comment web extension, which an integrates comments from different platforms, including apple podcast, google podcast and spotify. 

Our product is anti-censorship and permissonless, empowering content community.

Revolutionize your Podcast experience with one plugin, seamlessly integrating comments from multi-platform, while free content community engagement

Benefits:
-anti-censorship
-integrate fragmented comments into one page
-forge bonds between content creators and listeners
-enhance community engagements
how_its_made:
This project uses @walletconnect and the @lens_protocol to log in. We use the lighthouse to store comments data on IPFS, which is also friendly for the front-end to read the data.

We use React to design the Chrome extension.

We used Figma to design the pitch deck. 

In order to further increase social engagement, going forward, we may use @push to add on a notification function and @chilliz to incentivize the fans club. Furthermore, we will do content curation, discovery & recommendation based on lens social graph.
